title: Sage calendar record
description: A calendar record (CalendarRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another calendar record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

months.description: The months of a year, in order, with their lengths. Empty: twelve months of the usual lengths. (List<CalendarMonth>)

days.description: How many days it has. Unit: days. At least 1. (int)

months+.description: Adds to "months": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

days.description: How many days it has. Unit: days. At least 1. (int)

months-.description: Removes these from "months" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

days.description: How many days it has. Unit: days. At least 1. (int)

weekdays.description: The names of the days of the week, in order. Empty: Monday to Sunday. (List<string>)

weekdays+.description: Adds to "weekdays": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

weekdays-.description: Removes these from "weekdays" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

startYear.description: The year the clock's day 0 is in. (int, default 1)

startWeekday.description: Which weekday (0 is the first of Weekdays) the clock's day 0 is. At least 0. (int, default 0)

leapEvery.description: A year divisible by this is a leap year; 0: no leap years. Unit: years. At least 0. (int, default 0)

leapSkipEvery.description: Unless divisible by this too (a multiple of leapEvery; 100 in the Gregorian rule); 0: no exception. Unit: years. At least 0. (int, default 0)

leapRestoreEvery.description: Unless divisible by this as well (a multiple of leapSkipEvery; 400 in the Gregorian rule); 0: none. Unit: years. At least 0. (int, default 0)

leapMonth.description: The month that has the extra day in a leap year (1 is the first); 0: the last month. At least 0. (int, default 0)

seasons.description: The seasons, each starting on a month and day and running to the next one's start. Empty: none (the default calendar has the four usual ones) (List<CalendarSeason>)

name.description: The season's name, as the `season` condition names it. (string)

month.description: The month it starts in (1 is the first) At least 1. (int)

day.description: The day of that month it starts on. At least 1. (int)

seasons+.description: Adds to "seasons": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

name.description: The season's name, as the `season` condition names it. (string)

month.description: The month it starts in (1 is the first) At least 1. (int)

day.description: The day of that month it starts on. At least 1. (int)

seasons-.description: Removes these from "seasons" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

name.description: The season's name, as the `season` condition names it. (string)

month.description: The month it starts in (1 is the first) At least 1. (int)

day.description: The day of that month it starts on. At least 1. (int)

moonCycle.description: Days from one new moon to the next; 0: 29.53. Unit: days. At least 0. (double, default 0)

moonStart.description: How many days into the moon's cycle the clock's day 0 is (0 is a new moon) Unit: days. (double, default 0)
